about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Discovery Sport D150 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Discovery Sport D150 was introduced as part of the 2019 L550 facelift, alongside the D180 and D240, and remained in production until 2020 when the diesel range was simplified. It uses the Ingenium AJ200D/AJ150D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel that's part of Jaguar Land Rover's modular engine family. The D150 was the entry-level diesel option during its production run, and was discontinued in 2020 when the D150 and D180 were replaced by the single D165 badge. The Discovery Sport D150 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Land Rover Discovery Sport D150 Engine Codes Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D (L550, 2019–2020) A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the Discovery Sport D150 from 2019 to 2020 (L550 generation). Known for timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks over time — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium diesel rebuild. Do you rebuild Ingenium Discovery Sport D150 engines? Yes. We replace the timing chain, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium diesel rebuild. Do you supply used Discovery Sport D150 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Discovery Sport D150 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Discovery Sport owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Discovery Sport D150 from 2023 to present. The Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D rebuild.
